name: Jin Chan´s Pond of Riches
review:
A golden pond with the lucky toad Jin Chan, on a 5x3 grid with 15 lines. Multiplier wilds help in the base game, and in the bonus wins stick in place.

Because wins stay put, multiplier wilds landing later can build on them. The calm setting hides very high volatility and a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.27%, below average.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
